collections.name: Meta Piano
collections.description: Full 88-key upright piano with 4 velocity layers (352 samples). Warm, full character with medium sustain.

collections.name: Meta Nylon Guitar
collections.description: Multi-sampled nylon-string classical guitar. Six string zones, three dynamic layers (two picked, one fingerstyle), E2-B5, 348 samples total.

collections.name: Meta Steel Guitar
collections.description: Steel-string acoustic guitar multi-sampled per string, 6 strings chromatic across E2-C6 with 3 velocity layers each (375 samples).

collections.name: Oculus Audio Pack 1
collections.description: 289 game and VR sound effects from the 2015 Oculus Audio Pack: footsteps on six surfaces, themed UI sets, character vocals, doors, ambience loops, musical stings, horror and interaction foley. CC BY 4.0.
collections.attribution: "Oculus Audio Pack 01" by Oculus VR, LLC (https://developers.meta.com/vr/downloads/package/oculus-audio-pack-1/), licensed under CC BY 4.0. Files renamed to the UCS naming convention; OGG previews transcoded from the original WAVs.
